category_title: Silent English Language Learners with extensive digital literacy practices
minimal_context: Wei is sitting with his peers during group work in the traditional English classroom, where he has been assigned to deliver a 5-minute oral summary.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Wei, your group members said you are going to do the 5-minute summary for the presentation tomorrow. Let's hear what you have so far.

STUDENT: (Exhibits an absolute lack of communication in the traditional English classroom environment. He literally will not talk.)

TUTOR: You only have one day to prepare. What are you going to say?

STUDENT: (Never speaks, appearing to feel so uncomfortable and showing anxiety about failing.)

TUTOR: You need to participate in the group work. Just tell me one sentence.

STUDENT: (Maintains an absolute lack of communication, appearing so afraid of the group work and showing feelings of vulnerability.)

options.A: Incorporate frequent opportunities for the student to respond (OTRs) during traditional classroom instruction.
options.B: Develop a class website, including a public discussion forum for sharing ideas and questions.
options.C: Maintain a high ratio of praise statements to error correction statements (e.g., 3:1 to 10:1).
options.D: Design instruction in a straightforward and predictable manner to eliminate unnecessary complexity during group work.
